plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Orchestrator/worker session model over herdr or Orca; clean gates merge under a project standing order granting the orchestrator merge authority, else on the operator's word; operator gates and operator merge executors go to the operator.

plugins.name: merge-bar
plugins.description: The pull-request lifecycle against a merge bar fixed when the PR opens. Open a PR whose body carries seven fields (Claim, Scope, Known limits, Merge danger, Merge bar, Evidence, Closes); work it by sorting every reviewer finding as blocking or non-blocking against that bar, one push per round, with a stop at round 3 when the fixes are generating the findings, and non-blocking findings answered in the thread or recorded as known limits in the paired AI workspace's tech-debt ledger instead of filed as issues; review a PR as defect classes with every site, each sorted against that bar, in two parallel fresh-context axes (standards, and the Claim or spec), round 2+ on the fix diff only; teach a repository's reviewers the bar through an AGENTS.md Code Review Rules section and, on public repositories, a .coderabbit.yaml; and run a retro on the review record, proposing standards entries and deterministic checks for classes that repeat across PRs, written only when the operator accepts. Five prose skills, five slash commands, and `mb`, a bash and jq helper for the PR mechanics (review threads, checks, merge rules, blockers, a bounded wait for CI, thread reply and resolve), no state beyond one Markdown log.
